 \This routine is the INPUT TEMPLATE for the PATIENT STATUS file (#393)
 \The integration agreements and the processing logic defined within
 	his template enforce the business rules for record updates.
 \
129f147e: Kill and set up variables
2e150212: Check if there is any text in the descendent nodes of the record.

bbbe156d: Get user's response and handle timeout.
a96315bc: IKU -- No further action
34d82ecd: Increment the DIR("S") subscript for the next field.

565ebe56: If a pre-processor exists for the field, go process it.
d9d32b98: Validate null response based on field definition.
a198e806: If user enters "?", give help. If "^" is entered, quit.
c730ec74: If user enters just "@", refresh the screen.
9c0634be: If an XECUTABLE HELP is present, try to execute it.
ce2a793f: If the user input matches an entry in the DD, check the input data dictionary screen and execute it for any special logic.
8519a979: If the data element being edited is part of a multiple, go to the multiple loop.
20476554: If the field is a pointer to a file and the user input is not an explicit internal entry number, look it up in the pointed-to file.
e4f4e0d2: If the data type is not numeric and the user input contains more than 24 decimal places, truncate the input.
508c2df7: If the data type is numeric and the user input is a numeric range, convert to internal form.
9b338806: Execute any special computed cross-references.
7c49d66d: If the user input is not null or undefined, store it in the global and update the scrolling region, if applicable.
64dda479: Prompt the user for a valid response if the input is invalid.
b6ae9a1d: Set a default input value of '?BAD' for invalid user input.
8fc9188c: If the user enters a question mark, call the dictionary inquiry utility and loop.
4bd6c8cd: Set up internal variables for the current data attribute being edited.
3019797b: If there is a default response but the user has typed ahead, process the type-ahead response.
356c931c: If editing an existing value, get the existing value as the default response.
1380195e: If the existing value is a pointer to a file, get the external (.01) field value.
f34a68c8: If the existing value is a variable pointer, get the external (.01) field value from the pointed-to file.
6d158565: If the existing value is a set of codes, get the external value from the DD code set.
d6328580: If the user input matches the existing value, loop to the next field.
25696714: If the field has no input transform, go to the reader.
21acf674: If the field has an input transform, execute it and loop or go to the previous field.
